# P35.20b — Freshness `not_evaluable` + declared volatility classes + map suppression parity

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/301_P35.20b__freshness-classes-and-map-table-suppression.md`
(manifest row **301**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B — the **b-half** of the
PKG-10 public-number corrections: freshness stops asserting what was never
measured, and the accessible map table stops leaking what the figure
suppresses). Invoked `live_verification=false` — committed code only; **no
export run, no republish, no production mutation** — the corrected surfaces
arrive with the next export under that row's own authority. Closes
**ED-43** + **ED-44**; cites **SIG-METRIC-006/007**, **SIG-RECON-058**,
**SIG-UI-018/037**, **GQ-15**, **ADR-104(e)**, **ED-29**.
**Base:** `r11/P35.20a-per-dossier-provenance-unclamped-coverage` ·
**Gate:** none · **Production mutations:** none.

## The defects

- **ED-43 — freshness asserted success it never measured.** Every one of
  the 178 `/data-freshness/` rows read `ok` with **stale 0** and volatility
  `unknown`: `staleness_not_evaluable` was *computed* but never emitted;
  staleness was judged against a per-predicate vote that silently collapsed
  to a flat class, and **41 evidence-bearing sources had no row at all**
  (freshness iterated site sources only — procurement, legislative, CCOPS,
  federal sources went unreported while `evidence.json` counted them).
- **ED-44 — the accessible map leaked what the figure suppressed.** 601
  low-coverage cells printed **40,913 records** in the no-JS table and the
  SVG `<title>` while the figure suppressed them; the column header read
  "Devices" (SIG-RECON-058 forbids the census framing — these are
  observation-level records); and cell-to-jurisdiction assignment used the
  site's plurality jurisdiction, so per-key sums disagreed with the dossier
  denominators (CA: cell 662 vs dossier 6,139) with no disclosure.

## What ships

- **Registry declarations, fail-closed.** `connectors/registry.py` gains
  `volatility_class`/`volatility_basis` on `SourceRecord`: the class must be
  a member of the closed §28.3 vocabulary (IMMUTABLE/GLACIAL/SLOW/MODERATE/
  FAST/VOLATILE) and must carry a non-empty evidence basis; a basis without
  a class is rejected. `sources.toml` declares **279** classes — the
  `camreg_*`/`dot_511_*` emit surfaces, all `SLOW` under the ADR-104(e)
  recalibration (camera-registry predicates are dominated by
  registration/identity facts). **Every other source stays undeclared →
  `not_evaluable`. No class is ever guessed from names or claim mix.**
- **`inference/freshness.py`** — `SourceFreshness` gains
  `staleness_evaluable` + `not_evaluable_count`. `source_freshness()`
  evaluates staleness only against a *declared* class with ≥1 evaluable
  dated observation; otherwise `staleness_evaluable=False` and a
  non-evaluable result can never carry a nonzero stale count (constructor
  asserts).
- **`exports/shaping.py`** — the freshness emit now (a) reads the
  **all-predicate** observation set (latest dated `(source, subject,
  predicate)` observation, deduped), not just site-predicate claims; (b)
  builds rows over the **union** of freshness-observation sources and
  de-filtered `source_stats`/`source_runs` sources, so the 41 non-site
  evidence sources get rows and a source with a run but no publishable
  dated observation still gets an honest row; (c) emits
  `staleness_not_evaluable` + `volatility_class` and reads
  `status: not_evaluable` (never `ok`, never a fabricated `stale 0`)
  whenever staleness was not evaluated. `not-recorded` is preserved for
  absent run/content dates.
- **`exports/analytics.py`** — `_density_bins` accepts the placement run
  (`spine_export.py` passes it): each cell keys on the P35.19
  `jurisdiction_key` when a placement result exists, else the P35.18
  declared-scheme bucket — scheme-qualified keys throughout; each bin
  emits the **full `jurisdiction_counts` split** (a plurality label is
  never mistaken for the whole cell), canonical **`recordCount`** plus the
  deprecated `deviceCount` alias (one release cycle), and the
  `jurisdiction_rule` names the reconciliation rule in the payload.
- **`web/`** — `metrics.ts` adds `not_evaluable` to the status vocabulary,
  requires `staleness_not_evaluable`, and renders "not evaluable";
  the freshness page gains the column + note and suppresses the stale
  count for non-evaluable rows. `map.ts` adds the **one** suppression
  decision — `binCountLabel` — consumed identically by the figure, the
  SVG `<title>` (`binAriaLabel`, which also discloses every contributing
  jurisdiction key), and the accessible table; the header reads
  "Records + where SIG has looked". `data.ts` folds legacy
  `deviceCount` into `recordCount` at one seam.

## Tests (fails-if-removed)

- `tests/inference/test_freshness.py` — undeclared class → not evaluable
  with the dated set counted in `not_evaluable_count`; a non-evaluable
  result rejects a nonzero stale count; a declared class evaluates.
- `tests/exports/test_shaping.py` — undeclared source emits
  `not_evaluable` status/class; a run-only source still emits a row;
  `staleness_not_evaluable` is emitted into the row contract.
- `tests/exports/test_export_analytics.py` — bins key on placement
  `jurisdiction_key` / declared bucket, emit `recordCount` +
  `jurisdiction_counts`, keep the `deviceCount` alias; per-key totals
  reconcile with dossier denominators.
- `tests/unit/test_source_registry.py` — the closed vocabulary pin; every
  declared class has a basis and every basis has a class.
- `tests/db/` (seeded spine) — the freshness emit over real PG18/PostGIS;
  `test_run_completion` asserts the backfilled run dates land on an
  honestly `not_evaluable` row.
- `web/tests/unit` — `evaluableLabel`/validation, `binCountLabel`/`binAriaLabel`
  suppression parity, qualified-key disclosure, `deviceCount`→`recordCount`
  seam.
- `web/tests/e2e` (no-JS) — a non-evaluable source renders "not evaluable",
  never "ok"/"stale 0"; figure + `<title>` + table apply one suppression
  decision with no count leak.

## Number-trace re-derivation (oracle untouched)

Re-derived over a real `run_spine_export` build from the seeded spine
(`scripts/ci/build_from_spine_fixture_export.py`, PostGIS container — the
same path the national export runs; emitted bytes under gitignored
`docs/build/logs/p35_20b/`). C3-T284–T303's defect classes (all-"ok",
"unknown" volatility, stale 0) are gone: undeclared sources emit
`status/volatility_class: not_evaluable` with a positive
`staleness_not_evaluable`; C3-T002/T287's rowless non-site sources get
rows; C3-T317/T319's "Devices" framing is "Records" with `recordCount`
canonical; C3-T318's suppressed cells never print a count in table or
`<title>`; C3-T320's cell↔dossier disagreement is reconciled by
scheme-qualified keys + full `jurisdiction_counts` splits.
**Named residual R-P35.20b-1:** national magnitudes (601 suppressed cells
totalling 40,913; CA 662 vs 6,139; the corrected row count over 219
evidence sources) cannot be re-derived without the live spine — the next
materialization emits them. **Named residual R-P35.20b-2:** a source with
evidence artifacts but zero publishable claims still gets no freshness
row (rows cover claim-bearing sources); never fabricated.
